tools.name: ci_log
tools.title: CI Log
tools.description: Read qyl's own CI runs from its telemetry (dogfooding — no GitHub API). Without arguments: recent CI runs (sessions whose service.name starts with 'qyl-ci'). With run_id: per-leg phase breakdown, failures first, so 'which leg hung on what' is answerable even when GitHub's log API is down.

run_id.description: Session id of one CI run for a per-leg phase breakdown; omit to list recent runs.

error_count.description: Spans in the run that ended with an error status.

services.description: Service names observed in the run, at least one of which is CI-emitted.

items.description: One CI run, summarized from the session its telemetry is grouped under.

leg.description: Value of the span's ci.leg attribute, falling back to its service name.

phase.description: Span name, which the CI emitter convention sets to the phase name.

status.description: Outcome of one CI phase span, projected from its OpenTelemetry span status.

message.description: Span status message, present on a failed phase.

items.description: One phase span of a CI run, attributed to the leg that executed it.

mode.description: Whether a qyl MCP tool read live collector data or the explicit demo dataset.

outputSchema.description: Structured output for ci_log: recent runs, or one run's phases.

tools.name: display_mcp_dashboard
tools.title: Display MCP Dashboard
tools.description: Show an aggregate dashboard of MCP traffic (spans carrying an `mcp.method.name` attribute): request/error timeline, per-server and per-transport breakdowns, and per-tool latency and error rates. Prefer this when the user asks about MCP usage, tool health, or MCP monitoring.

mode.description: Whether a qyl MCP tool read live collector data or the explicit demo dataset.

stats.description: Aggregate MCP traffic statistics shown by qyl.mcp.

tools.name: display_traces
tools.title: Display Traces
tools.description: Show qyl traces in the interactive trace explorer with a span waterfall, detail panel, and correlated logs. Pass a trace_id to open one trace, a session_id for that session's traces, or neither for recent traces. Prefer this over list_traces/get_trace whenever the user wants to look at traces.

tools.description: List the metric instruments recorded for this project: name, kind (gauge/sum/histogram), unit, how many attribute streams exist under each name, and when it was last written. Start here — query_metric needs an exact instrument name, and this is where the names come from.

unit.description: UCUM unit as reported by the producer, e.g. `s` or `{request}`.

series_count.description: Number of distinct attribute streams recorded under this name.

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the most recent point recorded under this name.

items.description:
One metric name recorded for a project, collapsed across all of its series.
This is the catalog entry a client reads before it knows which series exist.

tools.name: query_metric
tools.title: Query Metric
tools.description: Run a time-bucketed range query over one metric: a window (start_time, end_time), a bucket width (step_ms), a reducer (aggregation: avg, min, max, sum, count, last, p50, p90, p95, p99), optional group_by attribute keys, and optional attr/attr_prefix matchers written 'key=value'. Returns one stream per grouping with its buckets. One bucket spanning the whole window collapses the answer to a single number.

step_ms.description: Bucket width in milliseconds. One bucket spanning the range collapses the query to a single value.

aggregation.description: Server-side reducer applied to the points falling in one time bucket.

group_by.description: Attribute keys to split the result by, repeatable. Omitted, every matching series collapses into one stream.

series_limit.description: Maximum result streams. A grouping that exceeds this is truncated, not refused.

name.description: Instrument name the query ran against.

kind.description: Shape of a stored metric stream.

aggregation.description: Server-side reducer applied to the points falling in one time bucket.

step_ms.description: Bucket width actually used, which may be widened from the requested step.

items.description: Key-value attribute pair following OTel conventions

attributes.description: The grouping key that produced this stream.

bucket_start.description: Inclusive start of the bucket, aligned to the query's step from the query's start.

value.description:
The aggregation applied to the points in this bucket. Null when the bucket
holds no value: either no point landed in it, or every point that did was
an OTLP `NO_RECORDED_VALUE` marker.

point_count.description: Number of stored points folded into this bucket.

items.description: One aggregated time bucket of a metric range query.

One result stream of a metric range query. With no `group_by` the whole
result is a single stream whose `attributes` are empty; with `group_by` there
is one stream per distinct combination of the requested attribute values.

truncated.description: Whether streams were dropped because the result exceeded the series limit.

outputSchema.description: The answer to a metric range query: what was asked, and the streams it produced.

value.description: An OTLP signed 64-bit attribute integer encoded without JavaScript precision loss.
An OTLP attribute double encoded as a JSON number when finite or a canonical named string when non-finite.

anyOf.description: Base64 bytes projected by qyl without colliding with an ordinary string attribute.
